title: Compatible alternating exact rows and their horizontal complex
statement: In an abelian category $C$ [def-sp-abelian], let $S$ be a cochain complex indexed by $\mathbb Z$. A compatible row system consists of families $A^p,Z^p,D^p,H^p$ and short exact sequences $0\to Z^p\xrightarrow{u^p}A^p\xrightarrow{v^p}D^{p+1}\to0$ and $0\to D^p\xrightarrow{w^p}Z^p\xrightarrow{x^p}H^p\to0$. It has augmentations $j_A^p:S^p\to A^p$, $j_Z^p:Z^p(S)\to Z^p$, $j_D^p:\operatorname{im}(d_S^{p-1})\to D^p$, $j_H^p:H^p(S)\to H^p$, with $j_A^pv^pw^{p+1}u^{p+1}=d_S^pj_A^{p+1}$, $i_Zj_A=j_Zu$, $i_Dj_A=j_Dwu$, and $\pi_Hj_H=j_Zx$. Its associated horizontal complex has terms $A^p$ and differential $v^pw^{p+1}u^{p+1}$; $u^pv^p=0$ proves square zero. Its augmentation has components $j_A^p$. No injectivity or quasi-isomorphism is included in the definition.
